upstream.author: Maksymilian Dendura
upstream.included: FFT, mip and persistent world-space foam WGSL kernels; adapted host integration

selection: Water > Ocean > Ocean rendering > web-ocean · spectral
backend: Native WebGPU on the existing Three renderer device
memoryScope: Compute buffers and simulation storage textures including mips. Excludes water geometry, scene captures, terrain masks and shared pore texture. Per-tile reservations are conservative; matching tiles share one provider within the same world clock scope and animation rate.

coverage: One shared provider across synchronized tiles
Separate histories for different animation rates
Surviving lease renders after another tile is disposed
Zero tracked raw buffer and renderer bytes after teardown
Coastal sky/refraction/shore composition with an independent pond
Injected asynchronous GPU failure retains document and redo, then retry succeeds
Detail/wind settings, switching back to Standard, undo, native save and autosave reload
Existing ocean/local-body authoring and allocation recovery
Native terrain/foliage/water, PBR export, resize and unavailable-device recovery
